issues_encountered: Independent rejection is based on three fresh reproducible valid-C++ cases, not author test failures or current gold corruption. No repair performed.

logic_errors.current_pinned_catalogue_impact: No matching lambda syntax found in masked pinned clif.cpp; not a proven incorrect current catalogue row.
logic_errors.finding: Lambda parameter shadows are not counted as declarations because declaration terminators exclude closing parenthesis. A same-spelled lambda-local PACKET_ZC_TWO p send is joined to outer PACKET_ZC_ONE p and published as fixed HEADER_ZC_ONE framing. Valid independently compiled C++ sends header2/length4 while recognizer claims header1/sizeof66. This is identity unsoundness, not full dataflow analysis.

logic_errors.current_pinned_catalogue_impact: No prefix packetType mutations found in masked pinned clif.cpp; not a proven incorrect current catalogue row.
logic_errors.finding: Header-write recognizer handles postfix but misses prefix ++p.PacketType and --p.PacketType. Both fresh negative cases classify fixed; real compiled C++ emits header2 and header0 rather than claimed header1. Unsupported header mutations must be unresolved.
